about_the_game:
Become the king of the road with the KR Vintage Cars - 60s and 70s Animation Pack! Kokoro Reflections is here with a massive set of MV/MZ-sized car character sheets to turn your empty roads into auto shows. 19 different characters inspired by 60s and 70s cars are ready to fill your streets with racing muscle cars, have convertibles cruise beachside roads, give your farms some fitting trucks, and more! Have your heroes travel the world in a VW-inspired bus so that no matter where they go they’ll always have a place to rest and recover, or let them zip around the highways in bright red hot rods with cool flared fins. Tell your players that your game takes place in the 70s by showing the roads filled with station wagons and rounded bugs, or use the pack’s stylish coupes to make your world feel modern without having to state a specific date.

Each car comes in 25 colors so your traffic jams can become rainbows of color! Fill the roads with NPC cars in browns, greens, and blues while your heroes and villains drive around in bright reds and purples so it’s always easy to see which cars are important. Let your players buy their favorite car and then attach specific buffs to different colors, so a teal car increases their magic attack while silver increases all defense and fuschia adds a boost to charisma. Or just give your players the option to repaint their cars whenever they want and have those changes show when they’re driving around! If you’ve been wanting to add more good looking cars to your games, pick up the KR Vintage Cars - 60s and 70s Animation Pack!


The Vintage Cars ~ 60s and 70s Animation Pack includes 19 body styles in 25 colors apiece. Types of cars include:

Race cars
VW-style vehicles (Bus and Bug)
Retro trucks
Station Wagon
Everyday cars
See screenshots for every body style available!


Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
OK for use in adult-rated games
